plugin_info.details: This plugin uses Open Babel to regenerate (correct) the 3D coordinates of compounds that are flat or have poor geometries.
plugin_info.title: Rebuild Compound Coordinates

user_args.description: Choose the quality level for 3D coordinate generation. 'Best' is recommended for accuracy but is slower.
user_args.label: 3D generation quality

options.description: fastest: no forcefield optimization or conformer search
fast: quick forcefield optimization, no conformer search
medium: quick forcefield optimization and fast conformer search
better: medium forcefield optimization and fast conformer search
best: max forcefield optimization and thorough conformer search
